title: All-in-One WP Migration Setup
description: Prepare safe migrations with All-in-One WP Migration — exports, imports, size limits, and post-move fixes.

steps.title: Take Pre-Migration Backup
steps.instructions: Export a full site backup before any migration. Store the .wpress file off-server and note plugin/theme versions.

steps.title: Resolve Export Size Limits
steps.instructions: Install the unlimited extension or use chunked export if the site exceeds free limits. Exclude cache and log folders.

steps.title: Plan URL Search-Replace
steps.instructions: Document old and new domain URLs. After import, run search-replace for serialized data using a trusted tool if needed.

steps.title: Import to Staging First
steps.instructions: Import to staging and verify admin login, permalinks, and media URLs before touching production.

steps.title: Disable Conflicting Plugins During Import
steps.instructions: Temporarily disable security, cache, and redirect plugins that may block large uploads or alter import requests.

steps.title: Flush Permalinks & Resave Settings
steps.instructions: Visit Settings → Permalinks and save. Re-save WooCommerce/EDD pages and menu locations if they break after import.

steps.title: Post-Migration Smoke Test
steps.instructions: Test homepage, forms, checkout, and admin tasks. Re-enable cache and security plugins and purge all caches.
